output.replacement_decision: Reuse the existing checkout-session token on ordinary retries; mint exactly one replacement only after explicit expiry, then reuse that replacement for subsequent retries.
output.rationale: `CONTRACT.md` declares this accepted, authoritative lifecycle and explicitly supersedes per-request token rotation. The executable reference returns `currentToken` whenever it exists and `tokenExpired !== true`, minting only otherwise; its contract tests verify both retry reuse and one replacement mint after expiry.
